rules.title: Transit-oriented area minimum allowable height and density

params.note: Minimum allowable heights by tier around SkyTrain stations and bus exchanges, from 4 to 20 storeys; the City of Vancouver designated 29 transit-oriented areas in June 2024. Tier boundaries come from the City's TOA map, which this tool does not yet read; the user confirms the tier.

source.title: Province of BC webinar (Bill 47 transit-oriented areas); City of Vancouver release, June 2024
source.section: Bill 47; Local Government Act transit-oriented areas; Vancouver Charter amendments
source.verify: Tier storey figures are the Province's SkyTrain-station tiers as commonly reported; confirm against the Transit-Oriented Areas Designation Regulation before the user sessions.

tiers_where.1: within 200 m of a SkyTrain station
tiers_where.2: 200 to 400 m of a SkyTrain station
tiers_where.3: 400 to 800 m of a SkyTrain station
tiers_where.4: within 200 m of a bus exchange
tiers_where.5: 200 to 400 m of a bus exchange

params.note: Minimum allowable heights and densities by tier: tiers 1 to 3 around SkyTrain stations, tiers 4 and 5 around bus exchanges. This version adds the bus-exchange tiers the 2024-06-30 version left out (found on 3475 E Hastings St, beside the Kootenay Loop bus exchange); they were in force from 30 June 2024, so a run dated before 17 Nov 2026 still reads the version without them. The tier comes from the City's TOA map, which this tool does not read; the user confirms it.

source.title: Province of BC, Transit-Oriented Development Areas overview webinar (18 Jan 2024); Vancouver Transit-Oriented Areas Regulation, B.C. Reg. 265/2023
source.section: Minimum allowable density and height by tier; bus exchanges tiers 4 and 5
source.verify: Tiers 4 and 5 (bus exchanges: 12 storeys and 4.0 FSR within 200 m, 8 storeys and 3.0 FSR within 400 m) are as the Province's overview and the City of Vancouver's TOA guidance give them; the regulation's own schedule was not read (its PDF text could not be extracted). Confirm against B.C. Reg. 265/2023 before relying on them.
